operations.question: Does the complete focus unit itself expressly require or authorize a return or destruction performance, certify completed destruction as an alternative, or impose a linked later return-or-destroy commitment? Use surrounding text only to resolve references; do not attribute its separate effects to the focus. A heading, a retention permission alone, a reference to disposal, or continuing confidentiality is not support. If the focus is incomplete and the proposition cannot be resolved, answer unknown.
